risk.rationale: The only verified evidence is F1, a LIKELY (0.6) new-device sign-in (PH-9900 vs usual LT-6002) mapped to T1078. It is uncorroborated and not confirmed as an account takeover chain. The password-spray claims are rejected as shared-egress background noise (186 and 208 distinct MFA accounts from those IPs), and the VPN-appliance KEV claim is rejected because vpn-edge-01 did not carry this account's sign-in. With no confirmed finding to override and no conflicting/insufficient exposure requiring a human, the weak unexplained signal warrants monitoring rather than containment, benign closure, or escalation.
